findings.summary: The report claims 'tests for the change were written and run,' but the diff touches only scripts/ingest.ts — no test file exists anywhere in the repo for embedAll/embedBatch (the script exports nothing, so nothing is even importable for a unit test). The new dual-cap accumulate/flush logic has real edge-case surface (exact boundary at 100 strings, exact boundary at EMBED_MAX_TOKENS, an oversized single chunk, empty input) that is currently unverified by anything beyond manual reasoning, contradicting both the report and the project's TDD mandate.
